description: Search the Georgia Milestones achievement-level descriptors: the official descriptions of what a student can do at each of four levels (Beginning, Developing, Proficient, Distinguished) for a standard. Use it for 'what does mastery look like' questions (e.g. 'what does a proficient 3rd grader do with fractions?'); it matches the descriptor text, not the standards' own wording. Returns `hits` with `item_code`, `level`, `descriptor_text`, `subject`, `grades`, and `statement` (the standard the descriptor belongs to), best match first; with lang='es', also `descriptor_text_es` and `statement_es` (the search itself matches the English text). Limitation: descriptors exist only for the subjects and grades the Milestones tests cover, so many standards have none.

grade.description: One grade: 'K' (or 'KG') or '01' through '12'. '1' through '9' also work.
grade.title: Grade

lang.description: 'es' adds Spanish text (Georgia Homeroom's translation; the official standards are English) beside the English fields. Default 'en'.
lang.title: Lang

query.description: Words to search for in the descriptor text, e.g. 'fractions'.
query.title: Query

name: search_mastery_descriptors
title: Search Achievement Level Descriptions
